python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json,os,pathlib,sys
from tumblrkit.account_runtime import OwnerOAuth
from tumblrkit.tumblr_read import TumblrReadAdapter
root=pathlib.Path.home()/".config/tgtumbler/tumblr-oauth"
print("ACTION=TUMBLR_ACCOUNT_POST_CONSENT_READBACK")
try:
 oauth=OwnerOAuth(root,None)
 status=oauth.status()
 print("OAUTH_STORED="+("YES" if status.get("connected") else "NO"))
 if not status.get("connected"):
  print("LIVE_IDENTITY=NOT_ATTEMPTED")
  print("LIVE_POSTS=NOT_ATTEMPTED")
  print("VERIFY=INCOMPLETE")
  sys.exit(43)
 selected=status.get("blog")
 oauth.blog=selected
 token=oauth.refresh_if_needed()
 identity=oauth.transport.get_json("https://api.tumblr.com/v2/user/info",token)
 user=identity.get("response",{}).get("user",{}) if isinstance(identity,dict) else {}
 blogs=user.get("blogs",[]) if isinstance(user,dict) else []
 matched=isinstance(blogs,list) and any(isinstance(x,dict) and isinstance(x.get("name"),str) and x.get("name","").removesuffix(".tumblr.com").lower()==selected for x in blogs)
 print("LIVE_IDENTITY="+("PASS" if matched else "FAIL"))
 if not matched:
  print("LIVE_POSTS=NOT_ATTEMPTED")
  print("VERIFY=FAIL")
  sys.exit(44)
 result=TumblrReadAdapter(selected,root/"access-token",token_provider=oauth.refresh_if_needed).perform("tumblr.list_posts",selected,{})
 print("LIVE_POSTS="+("PASS" if result.get("verified") is True else "FAIL"))
 print("POST_COUNT="+str(len(result.get("rows",[]))))
 print("VERIFY="+("PASS" if result.get("verified") is True else "FAIL"))
 sys.exit(0 if result.get("verified") is True else 45)
except Exception as e:
 print("ERROR_TYPE="+type(e).__name__)
 print("VERIFY=FAIL")
 sys.exit(46)
PY
